content: InputEvent: isComposing property - Web APIs | MDN: The InputEvent.isComposing read-only property returns a boolean value indicating if the event is fired after compositionstart and before compositionend. Baseline: Widely available.
conclusion: 证实 InputEvent.isComposing 为只读布尔属性，指示 input 事件是否发生在 compositionstart 与 compositionend 之间；在 300ms 自动展示逻辑中用于过滤拼音组合输入中的临时拼音字符，仅在非组合态或 compositionend 提交后才调度防抖展示。
